whenToUse: Mobile web and PWAs that use the full screen.
There are fixed headers and inputs at the top and bottom.
The side notch must be avoided in landscape.
whenNotToUse: Ordinary pages where the browser bar is always visible (they're already safe).
You'd apply it to every element regardless (only to the edges that need it).

alternatives.name: Sticky Action Bar
alternatives.reason: A button bar that handles the bottom padding too.

accessibility: The viewport meta needs viewport-fit=cover for the values to be filled in.
max() sets a minimum padding so it doesn't feel cramped on devices without a notch.
Pad only the edges that need it to save room for content.
In landscape, check the left and right padding too.
